doc: Lore data, synced to briefs/LORE_MASKS.md. Factions are lore only (voice lines, banter, key art, the wiki): squads in a match stay free-pick. A Hunter's story is its class file's "personality" (content/archetypes). relics: the found object that holds a fallen Hunter's self; status "proposed" is waiting for the owner's OK, so settling one is a one-line edit of that word. tools/gen_wiki.py writes the Lore page and docs/art/gen/stories from this file.
premise: The Wyrm came, and stole our essence. In time, humans, beasts and skyfolk alike were born without faces. We became a new race: the Empty.
Our only salvation became the cursed fossils we once tried to destroy: Relics, each carrying the soul of a fallen Hunter of old.
Malgrave, the queen who ruled Solmere and never aged, was the Wyrm in human shape. The night a thief reached its heart, it woke and broke the land.

factions.name: The Odd Jobs
factions.binds: The young, scrappy ones who grew up with nothing in the ruins after the Hollowing and look out for each other. Vex is the first Relic players meet, so this is the first crew they meet.
factions.wish: A world where nobody has to scrape by.

factions.name: The Fallen Court
factions.binds: Malgrave's arena champion, her court alchemist and her mask-stitcher. They knew her best and know what she really is, which makes them the most dangerous crew. They don't trust each other.
factions.wish: Each wants something different: Kael freedom from the demon, Cinder the throne, Lace the last loyalist dead.

factions.name: The Hearthguard
factions.binds: The ones who saved people the night everything broke.

factions.name: Moth & Hook
factions.binds: A duo in it for the treasure.

factions.name: The Void Jester
factions.binds: He belongs to no one and plays every side against the others.

banter: Kael and Cinder: the Blight she distilled burned the cracks into his arm.
Lace and anyone who served Malgrave.
Everyone and Sable: she started the Hollowing.
Vex and whoever didn't pay her.
The Odd Jobs: Vex's loyalty is technically for sale, but she sticks with them. Tenzo is the calm one.
Sable and Grimble: she opened the door, and he carries the loot out. Each thinks the other works for them.

relic.name: Her first coin
relic.why: The first coin she was ever paid. She flips it to pick her jobs.

relic.name: The lightning rod
relic.why: From the top of the spire where Rink, the boy she loved, fell. The storm struck them both there.

relic.name: A seeing-stone
relic.why: One of the three stones that float around him. It is how he sees the world.

relic.name: His broken chain
relic.why: The shackle he tore out of the arena wall, bound to the demon blade.

relic.name: The empty vial of Wyrm's blood
relic.why: She drank what she was told to distil. An ember still glows at the bottom of the vial.

relic.name: The stitched porcelain mask
relic.why: She sewed it from the masks she once made.

relic.name: The ship's compass
relic.why: Set in his chest now. It led his refugees home across the ice.

relic.name: Her ice skates
relic.why: The night she skated the festival crowd to safety.

relic.name: A glass globe of sun and rain
relic.why: It holds her little sun and her raincloud. The shelter's last fire, kept alive all night.

relic.name: Her moth-wing knife
relic.why: In her hand when she touched the Wyrmheart.

relic.name: His brass monocle
relic.why: He priced every treasure in Malgrave's vault through it.

relic.name: His jack-in-the-box
relic.why: Malgrave sealed him in it and threw it into the Void.
